title: Acknowledge authenticated retained-reading format before native installation
detail: An installing Joined owner may carry a separately authenticated retained reading with binary receipts while its native marker has no receipt floor yet. Its reading scope permits replay but cannot authorize native rows. After the existing baseline/key/authority/factor checks and fresh marker equality check, acknowledge floor1 using the same original real-format-task checks, fresh authenticated custody read, exact expected payload/record comparison, HMAC and native CAS as active acknowledgment. Rebind the local marker and native inbound scope before any installation owner initialization or binary effect. Keep the exported active acknowledgment active-only; only the private post-authentication installer calls the installing phase. Preserve every monotonic check, signature, chain, witness, native commit, lifetime, journal and erasure guard. The transition is independent of the fresh range-writer flag.
validation: A test-only Worker fixture re-encodes an already fully verified one-position ceremony result into the approved self-contained binary frame, keeping exact original signed request/page bytes and updates, and saves its own floor through the ordinary encrypted reader save. No database is edited and no verification is bypassed. The pre-repair reader-only app refuses opening with the existing generic Worker failure; no internal exception is captured, so that exception is not independently attributed. The source floor gap and isolated repair discriminate the result. Final reader-only and writer-on builds both install four binary native receipts, retain floor1, pass a read-only syntax census, exact exports on reopen, two-way writing, local Undo and exact offline cold. Final cases21,639ms and21,209ms, unchanged120s case/15s cold assertions. An earlier reader-only after run also passes and is kept. Guard AST review confirms the shared fresh-read/CAS body is unchanged apart from a private literal phase, the public API remains active-only, and all prior verifyJoinedAccount checks are exact after removing the new pre-effect branch. Types,55focused cases, five old Joined parser/MAC/downgrade controls and full330files/3,210pass/one existing skip pass138.16s (command138.884s,240s guard). Quality/format,17registry checks, inventory and10controls pass. One runtime hash and two corresponding construction line addresses change; all domains/obligations and old tests stay. The new one-case family is required.
summary: Before-refused genuine binary retained-reading installation now passes with the writer off and on. Native floor acknowledgment precedes copying, with all prior authentication/CAS/commit guards preserved. Both real-app cold/Undo cases and the full330-file unit checkpoint pass.
limitations: Fixture construction supplies a valid approved retained format; the ordinary ceremony still emits its ordinary one-position saved receipts. This is not a same-tree rollback image, old-artifact/stale-tab, lost-reply, RAM or performance acceptance result. Every floor rewrite/interruption lifecycle, actual stale-turn idle audit, B fairness/past-index and final image proofs remain; Stage5/6 remain. No format/trust/server/wire/limit/deadline change, commit, publication or deployment.
decisionTitle: Keep retained-reading format authority separate from native installation authority
decision: A valid retained reading’s floor never substitutes for a native marker acknowledgment. Authenticate the complete existing opening first, then perform the same fresh MAC-bound native floor CAS under the actual owner before the first installation effect, even in reader-only mode. Keep the public active-only entry unchanged in scope and the installing entry private with literal call sites. Use a test-only valid-format constructor instead of modifying saved data or weakening live/stored verification.
next: Prove interrupted/lost floor acknowledgment replies and marker rewrite preservation, then frozen old Page/Worker/stale-tab artifacts, actual mixed stale-turn idle audit, B fairness/past-index and same-tree writer-off rollback images. Continue automatically after each freeze.
